# A pop spark: a small faceted diamond 0.16 m, unlit peach; pooled: bursts when a star is caught.
new
material new Spark --base-color 0.9843 0.7333 0.6784 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Spark --size 0.16 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 45 35 0
material assign Spark
select all
shade flat
export spark.glb
